name: @pairflow/cli
description: CLI-first orchestration for Pairflow bubbles and local agent workflows.

scripts.test:smoke: pnpm codegen:reviewer-ontology && pnpm build && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts
scripts.build: pnpm codegen:reviewer-ontology && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --dir ui install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir ui build
scripts.typecheck: bash ./scripts/run-evidence.sh .pairflow/evidence/typecheck.log "pnpm typecheck" -- bash -lc "pnpm codegen:reviewer-ontology && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit"
scripts.lint: bash ./scripts/run-evidence.sh .pairflow/evidence/lint.log "pnpm lint" -- bash -lc "pnpm codegen:reviewer-ontology && pnpm exec eslint . --concurrency 4"
scripts.lint:fast: pnpm codegen:reviewer-ontology && pnpm exec eslint . --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location .pairflow/eslint-cache
scripts.test:root: pnpm codegen:reviewer-ontology && pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.test: bash ./scripts/run-evidence.sh .pairflow/evidence/test.log "pnpm test" -- bash -lc 'root_exit=0; ui_exit=0; pnpm test:root & root_pid=$!; pnpm test:ui & ui_pid=$!; wait $root_pid || root_exit=$?; wait $ui_pid || ui_exit=$?; test $root_exit -eq 0 -a $ui_exit -eq 0'
scripts.check: pnpm codegen:reviewer-ontology && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.dev:ui: lsof -ti :4173 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; pnpm build && pairflow ui
